title: Zohran and the Short Link: Simplifying Government Engagement Through Human-Readable URLs
summary: The article discusses how Zohran Mamdani, a New York City politician, effectively uses short, human-readable URLs (e.g., nyc.gov/{initiative}) in his social media videos to improve public engagement with government initiatives. These top-level links streamline access to participation, centralize digital interactions under NYC's official domain, and establish a consistent pattern for online civic engagement.
key_points: Short, human-readable URLs (e.g., nyc.gov/initiative) make government services more accessible and easier to engage with.
Centralizing links under a single official domain (nyc.gov) consolidates social media distribution and reinforces trust in the government's digital presence.
The approach establishes a predictable pattern for online civic interaction, improving user experience.
Follow-up actions (e.g., event participation) are directly tied to announcements, enhancing accountability and real-world impact.
